div.div:
Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. F1–F6 are logical record
bundles, expanded on the subsystem sheets. They group existing private stores; they do not assert a shared database. Repeated actors keep each subsystem interaction local.
F1: D1 (RW); F2: D1 (RW); F3: D1 (R), D2/D4 (RW); F4: D2/D3 (RW); F5: D1/D3 (R), D2/D5 (RW); F6: D2/D3 (R), D4 (RW). D1 identity/social; D2 content; D3 media/evidence; D4 conversation/memory; D5
playback/feed. Bundles retain private service ownership.
